This is a story of doting love as the expressionless but kindhearted Cerys is pampered to the core by the caring leader of the Knights, Jed!

title.native: 婚約破棄された無表情令嬢が幸せになるまで〜勤務先の天然たらし騎士団長様がとろっとろに甘やかして溺愛してくるのですが!?〜
title.romaji: Konyaku Haki Sareta Muhyoujou Reijou ga Shiawase ni Naru Made: Kinmusaki no Tennen Tarashi Kishi Danchou-sama ga Torottoro ni Amayakashite Dekiai Shite Kuru no Desu ga!?

204087.description:
Liese was shunned and feared as the "Witch of the Black Flame" and condemned by Prince Cain. Just when she thought her life was over after being sentenced to death, she was reborn as a baby! "I don't want to live that life again. I'll have a second life... a peaceful, happy life!" Having changed her selfish ways from her previous life, Liese hides her overwhelming magical powers and spends her childhood in hiding in the witches' village. All she needs to do is avoid being found by the ruthless prince Cain... Or so she thought, but Cain arrives earlier than in her previous life...!? Is there no escape in this life either?!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 冷酷王子と嫌われ魔女の幸せな人生計画～罪深き魔女は前世の咎を利用する～
title.romaji: Reikoku Ouji to Kiraware Majo no Shiawase na Jinsei Keikaku: Tsumibukaki Maju wa Zense no Toga wo Riyou suru

204088.description:
Rose, a daughter of the Kurga tribe, said to be a descendant of a witch, is forcibly brought to the royal palace to "cure the king's illness!" There she meets handsome, but incredibly eccentric princes...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

204089.description:
Idiot Alien Tourist x Earthling Workaholic: You XueChun is 3 years into an internship, having never used a vacation day. On the cusp of becoming an official employee, BOOM! Her manager turned into a zombie. Zhang HuoFen sat on the galactic bus for 100 years to finally tick earth off her bucket list. The bad news is, the zombie apocalypse is here. The good news is, no lines at the tourist destinations!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: I Don't RealMiss You, I'm in the Apocalypse

title.romaji: Wo Zai Moshi Bu Za Xiang Ni

204090.description: Note: Includes the one-shot Hichou no Tani (秘蝶の谷)

title.native: 異世界での冒険は愛猫を頭に乗せて！
title.romaji: Isekai de no Bouken wa Aineko wo Atama ni Nosete!

204092.description:
In the near future, Japan has seen the rapid spread of fully self-driving cars. The president of a company developing self-driving algorithms is held captive in his self-driving car by a mysterious man. The assailant, calling himself Mukarraf, demands that the Shuto Expressway on which the car is traveling be closed off, threatening to detonate a bomb planted inside the car if the request is not met. What is this man's aim?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: サーキット・スイッチャー

204093.description:
A collection of Rampo Edogawa's stories adapted into manga.

1. Yane-ura no Sanpomono (屋根裏の散歩者)
2. Hito de Nashi no Koi (人でなしの恋)
3. Injuu -Kage Naki Otoko no Kage- (陰獣-影なき男の影-)

title.native: 江戸川乱歩怪奇漫画館

204094.description:
After losing a war against a great power, a substitute princess, Xiaolan, is forced to marry the enemy country's cold-hearted prince, Arx, in place of the princess. Xiaolan investigates the enemy's situation and plots revenge, but she receives an unexpected favor from her hated husband...!?

A fantasy love story set in another world where the fate of a great power hangs in the balance!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 身代わりの偽姫は敵国皇子の寵愛になびかない
title.romaji: Migawari no Nise-hime wa Tekikoku Ouji no Chouai ni wa Nabikanai

204095.description:
Jiao He's a drunk good for nothing who comes home to find that his house is invaded by strange cats. With no other choice, Jiao He takes in the strange cats from another world into his home. To feed the cats and himself, Jiao He needs to get creative in the earning money department.

(Source: INKR)

synonyms: 死を呼ぶ呪われた人形
夜が怖い！呪われた人形

204097.description:
"So Chen Ge started exploring forbidden places to collect materials, incorporating elements from the scenes into his haunted house"

Chen Ge inherited a haunted house from his missing parents, but the business was failing until he stumbled upon a mobile phone while tidying up the haunted house. This changed everything. The haunted house could be repaired or even expanded by completing daily tasks of varying difficulty assigned by the phone. So Chen Ge started exploring forbidden places to collect materials, incorporating elements from the scenes into his haunted house. With visitors screaming in terror, the haunted house quickly became popular. However, as the mission brought more benefits, hidden dangers began to emerge, and even the clues to his parents' disappearance seemed to be related to it...

(Source: Comikey)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Wo You Yi Zuo Maoxian Wu

title.native: 好きやでって言わせたい!!

204099.description:
Despite her talent, Xuan Qiancao is continually humiliated and mocked as the daughter of a traitor. One day, she is helped by Chen Tongxue, a nobleman at the top of the hierarchy at the Grand College. From that moment on, she falls in love with him and works hard to become his servant!

(Source: INKR)
synonyms: A Poem of the Empire and a Thousand Piles of Snow
Rhapsody Of The Upper Country: A Thousand Pile of Snow

title.romaji: Shang Guo Fu Zhi Qian Dui Xue

204100.description:
In a car accident, Ling Cheng activated a magical delivery system. Get a 5-star rating, and you'll be able to redeem all kinds of skills in the system. So, here comes a super delivery guy!

(Source: WebComics)

204102.description:
Akari is a rookie teacher. At her last drinking party as a student, she gets drunk and loses her memory, and when she wakes up, she finds herself in a love hotel?! A young man is standing next to her?! And that man turns out to be one of her own students?! A dangerous, forbidden love begins between the rookie female teacher and a handsome, delinquent student!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: その恋は校則違反です
title.romaji: Sono Koi wa Kousoku Ihan desu

204103.description:
Norito Yonezawa is a low-energy high schooler with little interest in the real world. Yet he can’t seem to get his classmate, Hochiya, out of his head. Unlike him, she’s completely free-spirited: eating whatever she wants, whenever she wants, without giving a damn about what anyone else thinks. Before he knows it, he just can’t bring himself to look away from the polar opposite of who he is…

(Source: Yanmaga, translated)

title.native: 保知矢さんはあまりある
メイドに力負けするなんて恥ずかしくないんですか?
title.romaji: Maid ni Chikaramake Suru Nante Hazukashikunain desu ka?

title.romaji: Hoshino Yukinobu 50 Shuunen Shugyoku SF Senshuu: Setsuna

204106.description:
Isn't Cinderella in the fairy tale who puts on high heels and becomes a princess? Why I'm a man, who just temporarily wore high heels for fun, became a princess also?

(Source: WebComics)

204107.description:
Song Zhiyang, a college student who temporarily switched majors to pursue a design postgraduate program, meets the model he has always admired. However, he discovers an unwritten curse in the Experimental Arts Department that forbids romantic relationships. As he gets to know aspiring trainees and faces challenges from fans, his bond with the model deepens. Will they be able to break the curse and uncover the truth behind it?

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: Love You for Who You Are
title.native: 喜欢也没用，没用也喜欢
title.romaji: Xihuan Ye Meiyong, Meiyong Ye Xihuan

204108.description:
When humans beat the gods with wisdom, they invent a series of entertainment activities about gods. They catch the gods and let them fight each other. That's how the GBA competition has become a popular sport for all mankind. MC who hates the gods, is a god master of "God Capturer" group, participating in the capture and training of gods. Freedom or destruction? Where will the human beings to go?

(Source: WebComics)

204109.description:
After transmigrating to the world of immortal cultivation, Shui Wuyu discovered that he had an invincible ability, but he didn't expect that once he used it, his lifespan would be consumed. In order to survive, Shui Wuyu decided to become a mortal. However… "I just want to be a mortal!! Why do you all want to mess with me!!!"

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: The Invincible Me Just Wants to Be Ordinary

title.native: 无敌的我只想当个凡人
title.romaji: Wudi Di Wo Zhi Xiang Dang Ge Fanren

204110.description:
Signing a contract with the homebody Liu Liang through Internet, the Little Demon Boni was summoned to the human world, she didn’t realize that she was involved in the war between the deity world and the demon world...

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: The Coming-of-age Ceremony of A Devil

204111.description:
At the Changgwan, the musician So-seo, who played the biwa, meets Ki Se-Won, the first person to recognize his talent. Though he opens his heart to his warm demeanor, strange events soon unfold, and So-Seo, realizing Ki Se-Won is behind them, tries to escape. But he is already caught in his relentless grasp, and Ki Se-Won, watching So-Seo crumble, confronts the changes within himself.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

204112.description:
Public defender Luka stumbles into a conflict between angels and demons while investigating a case. He meets Albert, who’s secretly a demon, and their relationship quickly deepens.

Just as things start to heat up, Luka discovers Albert’s true identity—and learns he may be involved with a mysterious group that’s wreaking havoc in the human world. Now, Luka feels lost and uncertain about everything.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

204114.description:
The story takes place on Earth nearly a thousand years in the future. Following a great war between artificial intelligence and humanity, monsters known as "Tai Sui" roam the land, drastically altering the natural environment and societal structures. Humans invented a series of new technologies related to "BOX"—boxes—and, using these boxes as partners, fiercely resisted their enemies. The elite individuals capable of "resonating" with their box partners are called Box Masters. Rokuma, a previously overlooked and unremarkable Box Master, is chosen by the little dinosaur box "Theo" to begin a mission to protect the city-state...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Meng Shou Xia: Ji Jia Ji Yuan

204115.description:
Don’t sit around and wait for your hero to appear— you are your own hero.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

204116.description:
Qi Xing, your average high schooler, stumbles across a mysterious seven-star disc. But this ain't no ordinary frisbee. Suddenly, the disc drags him into the "Disc World"— a mind-blowing realm where his crazy adventure kicks off.

Through a twist of fate, Qi Xing becomes a cultivator, a master of countless Daoist techniques.

As he unlocks the secrets of the Seven Star Disc, a hidden power within him— the Primordial Celestial Qi—begins to awaken. But with every revelation, he gets sucked deeper into a conspiracy surrounding the legendary "Path of Immortality" through which he uncovers the truth about achieving immortality in the World within the Disc…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

204117.description:
The gods descended, invading Earth, and human civilization was driven to the brink of extinction! Guardian Lin Fan returns three months before the gods’ arrival. This time, he is determined to lead humanity to unite the entire nation’s power to stand against the gods!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Myth Invasion: I Kill Gods on Earth
Mythical Invasion: I Slay Gods on Earth

title.native: 神话入侵：我在地球斩神明
title.romaji: Shenhua Ruqin: Wo Zai Diqiu Zhan Shenming

204118.description:
In a game, the top game master Tu Lan received the message of seeking help from his full brother Tu Mu. After he got off the line and investigated, he discovered that Tu Mu in real world was actually a fake one. Tu Lan then logged into the game, trying to save the real Tu Mu, only to find he was unable to get off the line and was hunted by his former full-levelled account...

(Source: WebComics)

204119.description: A web manga published by Harta to promote their 2025 fair and rewards.

title.native: 「漫画誌ハルタ、お見知りおきを。」フェア開催中！

204120.description:
Im Do-Gyu, main vocalist of the group Runners High. One day on his way to a music show, Do-Gyu spots a male fan calling out his name. Realizing romantic relationships (!!) are happening within the group, Do-Gyu feels resentful that he, being gay, can't even meet a single guy. Then, he runs into the male fan who called his name in private. In a fit of anger, they end up sleeping together...

Only to find out later, this guy? He's not even my fan?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: The third story in Mago Creative's Idol Danpyeonseon (아이돌 단편선) Collection.

204121.description:
Outmatching the heaven and the earth, he is matchless and capable of everything. Challenging genius in humble and poor families, evil person from noble families, holy sons, monsters and beasts...he became the king who owned beauties and killed the strong! There is no limit for martial art, he can either be mundane or unworldly.

(Source: WebComics)

204122.description:
Mashiro has been the target of bullying ever since he started high school. He tries his best to deal with the physical and emotional torment, but his days turn even darker when his younger sister, the only family in his life, goes missing. Discovering that the bullies are involved in her disappearance, Mashiro finds a personal revenge service called "Rental Murderers" and seeks their help to get even. However, he is unable to contact them after he pays their fee using all the money he has saved up for his sister's college fund and assumes he has been scammed. Pushed to his breaking point, Mashiro attempts to end his life but is luckily saved by an unknown woman named Kiyoka who suddenly appears. She claims to be an agent sent by Rental Murderers, and...thus begins an epic journey of revenge!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: レンタル・マーダー～復讐のプロ、お貸しします～
title.romaji: Rental Murder ~Fukushuu no Pro, Okashi Shimasu~

204123.description:
The gal with a lovely smile was a bookstore clerk. A bookstore workplace comedy has arrived! Will this gal be able to save the town's small bookstore!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

204124.description: One of two volumes celebrating Harta's manga fair 2025 which include five original short manga starring characters from five different Harta manga.

204125.description:
Luna, a childhood friend of the devil twins Yui and Nagi, has been living as the future "mate" of her beloved Yui. However, when they meet again by chance, Nagi forces Luna to make a "mate" contract, and while her heart still loves Yui, her body becomes aroused by Nagi...!? Yui is a kind, twisted devil, while Nagi is a selfish, forceful devil. Who is Luna's destined mate? A love triangle fantasy of stealing and being stolen from each other!!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 双子の悪魔とつがいの月
title.romaji: Futago no Akuma to Tsugai no Tsuki

204126.description:
How arduous the Immortal Path truly is! And even more so in a cultivation world utterly transformed by a devastating plague. Mortals carry the pestilence within their bodies and once immortals come into contact with it, the best outcome is a drop in cultivation while the worst would be a return of their Dao to Heaven itself. Thus, immortals and mortals are forever divided. I crossed into this world filled with boundless ambition, yet could only struggle and flounder in the mortal realm, wasting away an entire lifetime. Fortunately, at the moment of my death, I finally awakened an extraordinary treasure—one that could turn reality into illusions, transforming a genuine life into nothing more than a fleeting dream, and send me back to the very moment I first transmigrated into this world. And so, my long road to immortality began.

(Source: Webnovel)

204127.description: One of two volumes celebrating Harta's manga fair 2025 which include five original short manga starring characters from five different Harta manga.
synonyms: メガネ漫画小冊子 [キュート]

204128.description:
A pure love story between a troubled college student and a high school student who has never known love. At 5 a.m. in the middle of winter, high school boy Kuraki Yuki encounters a handsome man sleeping in a garbage dump. Due to circumstances, Yuki ends up driving the man, Hasumi Kaname, home... And so the two begin their unusual life together!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: ねぇ、なぐさめてキスしてよ

204129.description:
You, who abandoned everything for the sole purpose of avenging your mother, and I, who was born in complete innocence and knew only you. In the end, have we composed a love story of awakening the puppet, or a lament for Hell drowned in anger and hatred?

(Source: MangaToon)

204130.description:
Lumen, a city on the farthest reaches at the edge of the feared magical borderland. Roy is an new F-ranked adventurer that wandered to Lumen on his own whim. Life on this monster-infested outpost should be a harsh burden for a newbie like him…however, Roy's actually top-class in both swordsmanship and magic?! The sudden appearance of this out-classed "novice" causes havoc in the world, starting in this remote city!

(Source: Alpha Manga)

title.english: The Carefree Frontier Life of the Strongest F-Ranked Adventurer
title.native: 最強Fランク冒険者の気ままな辺境生活？
title.romaji: Saikyou F-Rank Boukensha no Kimamana Henkyou Seikatsu?

204131.description:
Exhausted from work, Yu-Young reluctantly followed his boss up the mountain. There, he was unexpectedly kidnapped by the mountain god, a tiger deity who rules the mountain.

“From today, you are my husband.”

He attempts to escape failed time and again, and Yu-Young began to be swayed by the mountain god, San-Ho's, unexpected side...!

Will the two of them be able to hold their wedding?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

204132.description:
Shelly Natsu is a girl who suffered too much from school bullies' torment and died when she fell off a school building. After her death, she actually reincarnated into her classmate, the tall, rich, and handsome Ewan Duncan. While she begins her counterattack and takes revenge, she also begins an ambiguous relationship with Ewan's best friend, who was previously Shelly's secret crush. The most motivational story of all begins!

(Source: WebComics)

204133.description:
The interviewee turned out to be her one-night-stand man, which drove Maple Xia crazy. She thought she could fake her way out, but was stopped by this man, 'You want to escape after all you have done? I am your responsibility now.' Oh please! I was the girl and I didn't say such thing, hadn't this guy no shame? However, now that you requested strongly, I had no choice but to obey.

(Source: WebComics)

title.native: ロリセ合法の異国で●歳妻と毎日生交尾する
title.romaji: LoliSe Gouhou no Ikoku de ●-nen Tsuma to Mainichi Nama Koubi suru

204135.description:
“The war is on!”

Every night, Jiang Xiao Ya has a recurring dream of the same mysterious man. He’s got fire-red hair and indescribable power. One day, by pure coincidence, she meets him in real life! As it turns out, this man has a very important job: he’s guarding ancient, dormant beasts called the “Creation of the Gods.” To make matters worse, Jiang Xiao Ya inexplicably inherits the powers of Jiang Zi Ya, and gets drawn into the battle against these ancient beasts. A tale that transcends time and space unfolds!

(Source: Comikey)

Chen Huan used to be a top agent in China who recently got out of prison and is broke. He refused to come back to the organization to investigate an accident 13 years ago. This is a former agent's life out of prison as he saves and woos many girls around Nanhai City!

(Source: INKR)

204143.description:
News reporter: "President Li, what do you like to play in your spare time?" After thinking deeply for a while, President Li replied, "I like to play with my wife..." That night, a woman in tight spandex brandishing a leather whip appeared in front of a man. "I heard you liked playing with your wife?" "Wife, let me explain..." "How do you want to play? Standing up? Sitting down? Lying down? Or..." "Are you really doing it, wife?"

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Chichi no Kakushigo wo Seishori Onaho ni Shita

204152.description:
“I didn't want to say this, but seriously... are you obsessed with peppers?”

“What?”

Even at Un-o's harsh words, Ho-Beom doesn't back down. He tried his hardest to persuade him, appealing that his feelings for the guy were genuine, but Woon-Oh gave valid reasons why he couldn't accept Ho-Beom. Yet Ho-Beom was the kind of guy who could grasp a sliver of hope even in despair. In the end, for Woon-Oh, who was obsessed with ‘firsts,’ Ho-Beom decided to give him the first he could offer....

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: The second story in Metatoon's Yeonhagong Danpyeonseon (연하공 단편선) Collection.

204153.description: What if you lost all your memories and were suddenly thrown into an unfamiliar world? And what if you couldn't understand a word the other person said……? In this new world, with this unknown girl. A survival communication story in a different world, starting from zero knowledge, begins!

204154.description:
4 different stories about people that are anemic.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

204155.description:
The man steps into a secret club shrouded in mystery, a place he had only heard about in whispers. Inside, he finds a hidden world where countless beastmen exist to fulfill every imaginable desire. As he is drawn into the unfamiliar stage performances and a private encounter with a catman, the club manager appears with an innocent newcomer, a cowman. After introducing him and giving the guests a small taste, the manager makes a dramatic announcement. The man has been chosen as the one who will be the first to claim and shatter that innocence everyone has been craving…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Bimilkeulleom Danpyeonseon (비밀클럽 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [ヒミツ倶楽部短編選]飼い慣らしてください、ご主人様！

204156.description:
Ji-Wan and Hee-Woo are two wealthy, good-looking twenty-six-year-olds from elite Korean families. Despite their perfect appearances, each carries a fatal flaw. Ji-Wan lives recklessly, addicted to luxury and excess, while Hee-Woo drifts through life numb and uninterested in anything around him. When Ji-Wan’s father suddenly cuts off his credit cards, his lavish world collapses overnight. Desperate to afford a limited-edition coat he refuses to give up, Ji-Wan turns to a supposedly easy, high-paying side job at a secretive private club and convinces his childhood friend Hee-Woo to join him. Expecting nothing more than pouring drinks and entertaining guests, Ji-Wan instead finds himself pulled into situations far beyond his control, while Hee-Woo, long bored with life, begins to awaken to a dangerous new thrill.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Bimilkeulleom Danpyeonseon (비밀클럽 단편선) Collection.

204157.description:
In the 21st century, Ye Kong, a young man on the earth, accidentally travels to a world of cultivation where killing, snatching, and law of the jungle prevails, with the help of the body of a poor youth, he is reborn and gets acquainted with various characters. Under the guidance of a unique and rare book, Ye Kong embarks on a new and interesting journey of immortality cultivation.

(Source: WebComics)

204158.description: After witnessing the murder of his parents by Destron and becoming Kamen Rider V3, Shiro Kazami dedicates his life to fight the evil organization.

title.native: テレビマガジン版　仮面ライダーV3

204159.description:
Rikka has never been able to forget about her ex-boyfriend, Kazuto, from middle school. Even though they go to the same high school, Kazuto won't even look at her, let alone talk to her. Meanwhile, Kazuto has lost his memory from his second year of middle school onward...!? A heart-warming love story filled with the feeling of youth!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

204160.description:
After losing her daughter in a freak accident, Kae encounters a doll at an antique market. Kae cherishes the doll as if it were her own daughter, and her emotional wounds gradually begin to heal. However, when the couple gives birth to a new daughter, the doll begins to destroy the family's happiness. The nonstop story unfolds in this comic with stunning depictions and powerful expressions. There's something strange about the doll in this house...

A spine-chilling doll mystery!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

204161.description:
One day, an old man walking through town unexpectedly ends up buying a used android named “Hama-san” at a bargain price! However, despite being a military robot, she's a complete mess with tears in her eyes...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ぽんドロイド！ はまさん

204163.description:
Noi Galeneé, the country's greatest magician, lives alone in the mountains on the outskirts of town. One day, she receives an order from her country to watch over and defeat a boy who is possessed by the Demon King. However, Noi gives the boy the name "Cardia" and accepts him as her apprentice. The two spend warm, peaceful days together. However, the day of the Demon King's awakening draws closer with each passing moment...

The century-long story of the solitary magician Noi and the lonely boy Cardia begins now.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: And Thus, 100 Years Later, the Wizard Neu Galene Became a Bride.
And Thus, 100 Years Later, the Mage Noi Galeneé Became a Bride.

title.native: かくして魔法使いノイ・ガレネーは100年後、花嫁となった
title.romaji: Kakushite Mahoutsukai Noi Galeneé wa 100-nengo, Hanayome to Natta

title.native: 朝と昼と夜とそれから
title.romaji: Asa to Hiru to Yoru to Sore kara

204166.hashtag: #マリッジブルーの僕たちは

title.native: マリッジブルーの僕たちは

204167.description:
After being bullied and consequently dying in a tragic car crash, Lin Yuan, an ordinary high school student, finds himself in a parallel world where he becomes a Godzilla-like monster. Aiming to become the most powerful creature in this brand-new world, he will check in with a system to gain "Evolution Points" to cultivate himself to realize his maximum potential.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Rebirth to Be Mythical Creature as What Monster?

204168.description:
A special forces soldier, Lin Yuntian was assigned on a mission searching for the ancient jade. During the mission, his soul accidentally broke free from his body and travelled through the multiverse and embodied in another body. The owner of the body was previously set up by his opponents and ended up losing everything he had.

(Source: WebComics)

204169.description:
100 years ago, a dimensional doorway was opened for reasons unknown, and the world has been plagued with disasters ever since. A group of extraordinary individuals who have been dubbed the heroes are sworn to save the world.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Calamity and I: The Dual Ascension

204171.description:
Stunning and pure, she is like the camellia at night. Insensitive to romance, she fell for her bodyguard after many turns and twists. He was the boy who she considered her enemy 12 years ago. What's worse, he was her senior whom she once flirted with…

(Source: INKR)

204172.description:
The daughter of an earl, Clarice, was trapped by Loretta, also known as the "Cat Burglar," and was hated as a "villainous young lady," before dying an untimely death. However, she suddenly finds herself transported back to when she was 10 years old, where she meets Felix again, who is about to break off their engagement. In order to avoid ruin, Clarice continues to act differently from her first life. And before she knows it, she is highly regarded by those around her, and has gone from being "hated" to being "loved"...!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: 憎まれ悪役令嬢のやり直し 今度も愛されなくて構いません
title.romaji: Nikumare Akuyaku Reijou no Yarinaoshi: Kondo mo Aisarenakute Kamaimasen

204173.description:
Hazuki (26 years old) works in the apparel industry. She loves her job, but her lack of experience in love is a complex... She was beginning to feel discouraged by the cold attitude of new employee Nanase, but an unexpected turn of events awaits her...!? "You're getting excited like that... so cute," she says, as she begins a "non-innocent adult romance" with a younger boy who is surprisingly aggressive♡.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 七瀬くんはウブじゃない。

204174.description:
Being a singleton, the occupation of professional vet, Anna Ling, is to mate animals. In a pet shop filled with hormones, a celibate and sorehead store manager was assigned! Meanwhile, being troubled by both family pressure and mysophobia, how will he fight back?

(Source: WebComics)

204175.description:
Famous female live-broadcaster You Mao was mysteriously kidnapped, but the kidnappers began to question the various suspicious points involving the incident, resulting in them killing each other out of doubt. By the time Yang Haoyu appeared, the scene was already full of dead and injured people, but everything is just the start of his revenge...

(Source: Coolmic)

204176.description:
A hidden murderer lives in a seemingly quiet and peaceful magical town. When the two girls arrived in this town, they thought they could learn magic happily until they became terrified. Who is the murderer who has been traversing the magical and mortal realms...? How will the two girls' love and hatred be balanced? Welcome to another Shoujo-Ai thriller series involving magic.

(Source: INKR)

204177.description: Note: Includes the one-shots "Sewayaki na Rinjin ga Oshikaketemasu (世話焼きな隣人が押しかけてます)" and "Narenareshii Joushi ni Horekaketemasu (馴れ馴れしい上司に惚れかけてます)" and one extra chapter.

title.native: どうしても相容れない

204178.description:
When she first entered the workforce, she was sure she had her fair share of romance... But when she started using an app hoping to find love again, she couldn't find anyone suitable. The one who "liked" the depressed Michi was a handsome guy with a good face, a high income, and a good annual salary, who also seemed to have a good personality!? The two hit it off and decided to meet for the first time, but who showed up...?! A unique and heartwarming love story ♪

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)
synonyms: Matching App de Deatta Kare wa ￮￮ Deshita.

title.native: マッチングアプリで出会ったカレは○○でした。
title.romaji: Matching Apuri de Deatta Kare wa ￮￮ Deshita.

title.native: バテン・カイトス 真実の破壊と約束の嘘
title.romaji: Baten Kaitos: Shinjitsu no Hakai to Yakusoku no Uso

204180.description:
When she was betrayed by her fiancé and sister, she was so grief-stricken that she agreed to a blind CEO's unexpected love confession. She became his babysitter before realizing she wasn't privy to the full picture. He needs someone to feed him, dress him, bring him his towel when he forgets them in the shower, and cuddle him at night. Thus begins a marriage on unequal terms...

(Source: WebComics)

title.native: 世話焼きな隣人が押しかけてます

204182.description:
I was forcibly kissed by a handsome guy, twice! But it wasn't cool. Who do you think you are? Am I a girl you can kiss at will? Huh? You said you want to marry me? No way! I ran away from my home exactly because I don't want to get married! But here's a handsome guy says he must marry me? Why are all these guys all into me...

(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: Entangled With His Cold Excellency, the Scourge
Accidentally in Love With the Devil Prince

204183.description: If the legend that says Chang'e flew to the Moon is true, the elixir of life really exists, and you must kill to survive... Will you fight alongside your Immortal Spirit against old deities? A doomed young man embarks on a journey to find his little sister, only to watch the flight he took crash. In the moment between life and death, he has a vision of the immortal tomb in the Moon Palace and forms a contract with Chang'e. From now on, he is the master of Chang'e and the only way for him to survive is to fight other Immortal Spirits to the death... An ethereal figure takes shape in the Moon Palace! Tonight, the goddess of the Moon makes an appearance...

204184.description:
"After an immense battle, the Ninth Son of the Golden Crow Family was reincarnated as Ye Xingchen"

The Phoenix of Chaos descended upon the world with the power to burn everything down to ashes which inflicted terror for centuries. It was the ruler of Heaven and Earth! When the crown prince of the Chaos Phoenix was reincarnated, he stirred up trouble throughout the world. The king had been reborn to start his journey afresh!

(Source: Comikey)

synonyms: I fell in love with my overfamiliar boss.

title.native: 馴れ馴れしい上司に惚れかけてます

synonyms: Why do I want to be praised by you?

title.native: 褒められたいのはSubのせい？
title.romaji: Homeraretai no wa Sub no Sei?

204190.description:
The world is contaminated. Supernatural abilities awaken, ushering in a new era. My ability? I can grant abilities to others to awaken the powerless and make the powerful even stronger. But every ability I grant eventually returns to me. Level-A, Level-S, Level-SSS…even Level-X! Your abilities become mine, and mine only! However, from the depths of cosmic corruption, monsters have emerged… and their abilities are Rules. Dream of them, you die. If they see you, you die. Even hearing their footsteps means death.

(Source: WebComics)

204191.description:
I woke up to find myself reincarnated as a princess, yet to my surprise, I was disliked by the monarch and was set up by my bastard sister. I thought I had run into my true love, yet he turned out to be a reborn person who is out to get revenge on me! How can I turn the tables and become the monarch's most beloved little princess?

(Source: WebComics)

204192.description:
"1 million is your limit!" "I know I'm handsome, but you can't keep looking at me like that, or else I'll get embarrassed." "Once you put it on, you can never take it off." He gave her both extreme love and harrowing pain. In this unbalanced life, when could she find her Mr. Right?

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Di Shao, Ni Laopo You Pao Le

204193.description: Gu Que came to a new world after traveling through time and space. It should have been a lucky experience, but he was envied by the heavens. He became the son of doom, had a third eye and would be dogged by misfortune. To revive his wife, he started his journey of getting magical tools, killing the crown prince, fighting the whole continent and meeting new hotties. After all this, he'd finally become the master of disaster in this world!

title.romaji: Wo Zhende Bushi Eyun Zhi Zi

204194.description:
Zhao Menglin was reborn as a wimpy daughter of an aristocratic family with inferior body constitution which can't cultivate immortal. She was framed by her stepmother, detested by her younger brother, and looked down upon by all the others! Through all the adversities, she met a mysterious celestial master who took her to the higher stage of cultivation and counterattacked all the humiliations. Eh? Why does the celestial master look her... in such a spoiled way?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Nitian Di Nü: Xian Zun, Chong Shangtian!

204195.description:
Fabio Lee accidentally traversed space and time and entered the Origmax Realm... into the body of an idiot…(*sigh*). Time to give up? Never! Cultivating and leveling up, watch him complete his nirvana from an idiot to a martial art master and all the way to the peak of the Origmax Realm.

(Source: WebComics)

204196.description:
Tang Feng, born and raised in a village, has been a poor and pathetic loser and burdened himself with a usurious loan to cure his parents. With back against the wall, he scans a mysterious QR code, and surprisingly makes friends with the gods! The God of Wealth makes him rich and the Matchmaker takes care of his love relationships. His life is now looking up!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Strongest Circle of Friends in the Immortal Realm

title.english: Friend with the God of Wealth

204197.description: A strange twist of fate led the highly acclaimed actress, Ye Zhen, to be reincarnated as the empress of a distant land and time. When she thought that things could not have gotten worse, she found herself in another dilemma–she and the emperor had suddenly switched bodies! She became the master of a glorious nation, not to mention the royal harem, while the emperor became one of her many lovers. "Well then, I'll rule the country while you deal with those ladies in the palace. Hold on… Why is there so much work to do? Do I have to go through all these paperwork?!"
synonyms: I Want to Be the Emperor
I, the Empress, Will Become Emperor

204198.description:
Heath is the giant Dragon of Space-Time and leader of the Demon Race. After he was sealed away in the Ancient War by a human sage, he used his space-time abilities to study the cultures of worlds in other dimensions, becoming a homebody extraordinaire. Yet one day the sage unlocked part of the seal, and Heath set off on a new journey as a junior adventurer, in a world that is familiar yet new to him...

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: The Black Dragon Emperor's Redo Adventure
The Evil Dragon Turned Into a Junior Adventurer

title.english: The Dragon Emperor Becomes A Junior Adventurer
title.native: 成为初级冒险者的黑龙大人
title.romaji: Chengwei Chuji Maoxianzhe De Heilong Daren

204199.description:
The beast-like CEO is trying to lure me into his bed! As a man with a beast inside, is there still hidden tender love? For all those days, I have been sharing a room with the beast, and I end up getting to know more of his kind…how could I keep my chastity after accidently stepping into the beast lair?

(Source: Webnovel)

204200.description:
When the youth Chen Fengjiao was born, there were anomalies in both heaven and earth. Each time he was attacked by evil spirits, he would saved by the leading female character Hu Qian, who was actually a fox spirit. To help Hu Qian thoroughly remould herself, Chen Fengjiao saved her at the risk of his own life, as a result, he finally won her heart. Jack shall have Jill, however, their marriage finally led them to destruction!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: I Have a Date With the Fox Spirit!

title.romaji: Wo He Hu Yao You Ge Yuehui

204201.description:
"I want to get married for love when I'm around 25. I want to have two kids. I want to have a cat or a dog..."

Haruka had such dreams, but in reality, she's 28 and boyfriend-less. She's on the verge of turning 30, and her heart is racing as her friends get married...she's completely on the brink of love!

"The next boyfriend I date is the one I'll marry."

And yet, through a series of unexpected events, she starts living together with a younger guy from work! What will happen to this romance!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 取り急ぎ、同棲しませんか？

204202.description:
"I've never had a kiss that made me feel like I was going to get eaten up like this..."

Normal, safe, and solid. These are the words that Ichika has lived by for the past 30 years. She was thinking about getting married, but one night, her boyfriend dumped her, calling her boring. She meets a young man who calls himself "Wolf" at a bar. Wolf says he "likes" Ichika, and suggests that they begin a "thrilling romance"...

Wolf's love is forceful, sweet, and a little dangerous...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: オオカミくんと恋の晩餐

204203.description:
A prince-like high school boy and an ugly female teacher, in a contract marriage!?

Good looks and good manners. I'm known by those around me as a prince, but for some reason I've ended up in a contract marriage. And what's more, my partner is Iwasaki Kinuko, a perverted virgin teacher who's extremely ugly in both face and personality!!! Ahhh, there really is no way a woman would force herself on me like this, sexually harassing me.

Hmm... but when I kiss her, she makes this face...Why am I accidentally falling for this old woman!?!? No way, no way!! This is impossible!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 王子様はマリッジブルー

204204.description:
Hibari Hit Comics presents a work of neo-horror for baseball fans.. what the hell is that? The bizarre—or rather, macabre (?)— fate of a young Yomiuri Giants fan. A bewildering terror that begins with the realization he alone witnessed a Giants loss.

(Source: Shoshisaba, translated)

204205.description:
Nagase is a handsome, efficient boss who is incredibly popular with women. When Taki finds out Nagase's "secret," she discovers a surprising side to him...

A sweet and romantic office romance begins!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

204206.description:
It's a big day for our protagonist, Usagida. She gets on an early train, unable to suppress her worries that something might go wrong during her high school entrance exam. Trying to go over her notes just makes her anxiety worse... When she finally can't help but burst into tears, a certain someone calls out to her...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: なんにもうまくいかなかったらどうしよう
title.romaji: Nanni mo Umaku Ikanakattara Dou Shiyou

204207.description:
"I'll die if I don't have a boyfriend!" Izumi cries out, and by chance she ends up dating the handsome secretary-general of her club. Izumi, a romance novice, is constantly thrilled when her boyfriend, Genma, treats her like a girlfriend. However, Genma's true nature is that of an ultra-carnivorous man...?!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Notes:
- Includes the one-shot "Suki Datte Iwanai Kuse ni (好きだって言わないくせに)".
- Includes the one-shot "Boku wa Maiko no Neko (ボクはマイコの猫)".
- Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 今日からカノジョになりました。
わがまま男は一途に恋する
title.romaji: Wagamama Otoko wa Ichizu ni Koisuru

204209.description:
"I heard Midori's boyfriend died in high school."
"Haruto... I hear you look like him."

Rated as the most beautiful freshman, Midori is the subject of rumors throughout campus. She may be pretty, but she's probably just a bitch, Haruto thought, deciding to ignore her. But when he actually talked to her at the welcome party, he discovered she was an innocent girl who'd never had a boyfriend! Does that mean she's a virgin? ...Haruto suddenly wants to protect her, so Midori says, "If you're a senior, I'll be happy," and takes him to a hotel! Confused, Haruto pushes her down...?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

204211.description:
Becoming the fake fiancée of the popular, playful student council president!?

Tachibana Mayuka transfers to a boarding school. At that school, the incredibly handsome but playful Yuki Nozomi reigns as the student council president. By chance, Mayuka becomes Yuki's fake fiancée!? She's just pretending to be his fiancée... even though she doesn't really like him... Mayuka finds herself increasingly drawn to Yuki, who is selfish and perverted, but sometimes kind!? A tsundere high school girl is forcefully loved by a playful, self-centered guy in this sweet and spicy fake marriage love story★

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

204212.description:
Fuka is a high school student who became fascinated with the "world of Japan" after attending a tea ceremony with her grandfather, a Japanese confectioner, and now aspires to make Japanese sweets. She dislikes Tsujido Kaede, the most popular boy at school and whose family is a famous tea ceremony master. However, after school, in the tea ceremony club room, he shows interest in the sweets she has made, dresses nicely, and serves tea, revealing a more Japanese side to him that is the complete opposite of his usual frivolous personality...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

204213.description:
Kotomiya Fuuko is a plain office lady in her 30s who lives for her work. Following the will of her mother, who was her only family, she ends up marrying her childhood friend, popular actor Niinami Rin! Of course, this is a secret from everyone. Then, Kaihoku Mikuru, an actress who is a co-star killer, suddenly becomes close to Rin!!!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

204214.description:
Hami, who dreamed too much of love, suddenly found herself a sophomore in college. Thanks to her half-brother, Riku, who enrolled at the same university, she ended up going on a date with Mizuki-senpai, a boy she has a crush on. But behind the scenes, Riku, who is obsessed with Hami, has his own motives...

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: ないものねだりの恋たちは

204215.description:
Facing a calamity that left chaos and destruction in its wake, mankind's survival was hanging in the balance. The only solution? Get a job and get good! Some became mages, other summoners. However, Cloud, a promising student with a great future ahead of him refused to get a job! Being jobless is his true calling!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: 無職だが神を滅ぼした
Job Changing for the Entire Population: The Jobless Me Will Terminate the Gods
Tôi – Kẻ vô chức đã diệt thần
I'm A Loser And I Killed The Gods

title.english: The Jobless Guy Who Has Come to Slay
title.native: 全民转职：无职的我终结了神明！
title.romaji: Quanmin Zhuanzhi: Wuzhi de Wo Zhong Jie Le Shenming!

204216.description:
Fourteen year old Yui Ishii wanted to die. She tried to kill herself many times, but now, for the first time, she wants to live. In a white room, 333 people who share the surname Ishii are gathered together. If they fail at the given task, an explosion will kill them instantly, and only one person can survive this death game.

At the Fushimi and Hachisuka detective agency, a call to help find the stage actor named Yuu Ishii. He was known for his unsettling performances, but he disappeared just before the final performance of his latest show.

What happened to Yui and Yuu, and why were the 333 people named Ishii chosen?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

204217.description:
Itsuki Kageyama, who is socially awkward and struggling at work, finds her only joy in an online game. One day, she meets Yoru, a beginner player in the game. As they spend time together in-game, the experience gradually begins to open Itsuki's heart.

(Source: Bungeishunju, translated)

title.native: 今夜、エーテルで待ちあわせ
マネ×ハメ〜女子マネをハメ倒す中出し部活動〜
title.romaji: Mane x Hame: Joshi Mane wo Hame Taosu Nakadashi-bu Katsudou

204220.description:
Noelia, the daughter of a duke, is falsely accused and her engagement is annulled, and she is to be married off to the king of a neighboring country. Noelia was meant to become the neighboring country's "figurehead queen"... But then, suddenly, a man kidnaps her. He seems to know Noelia, but with no memory of her past, Noelia has no idea who he is. Even so, when she sees him, she feels so sad she wants to cry... A love story between a crown prince who was supposed to have been wiped out and a young lady who has lost her memory!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 冷遇されるお飾り王妃になるはずでしたが、初恋の王子様に攫われました！
title.romaji: Reiguu Sareru Okazari Ouhi ni Naru Hazu deshita ga, Hatsukoi Ouji-sama ni Sarawaremashita!

204222.description:
It’s the last summer of high school for drama club best friends Yuki and Natsu. While everything’s going well for Natsu, Yuki instead finds herself caught in mental turmoil... See the portrayal of one youthful summer in this fiery theater tale!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

204223.description:
High school Second year Izumi is surrounded by girls that are a little peculiar: haughty rich girl Shinonome and gamer junior Akaishi. Even his childhood friend and a transfer student turn up out of nowhere. It is the early 2000s. A nostalgic, heartwarming romance that tickles your memories of "those days" begins now!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 呪い人形に皆殺された

204226.description:
Hinata, an employee of a black company, is summoned to Exia, a human country in another world, as a "Saint." However, even there, it is a corrupt black country. Hinata tries hard to do her new job, but is discarded as a nuisance when a junior saint appears. She ends up being held prisoner by the demon kingdom of Dominus, but there she meets a young demon named Atlas, and they hit it off over work-related complaints! Then, the story takes an unexpected turn...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 聖女と魔王の偽装婚約～手に手をとってホワイト国家を作ります～
title.romaji: Seijo to Maou no Gisou Konyaku: Te ni Te wo Totte White Kokka wo Tsukurimasu

204227.description: A horror manga originally published by Hibari as part of their Hibari Hit Comics label. It was later published digitally under Magazine House.

204228.description: A collection of four very rare horror manga volumes from the 80s that were originally published by Hibari. Three of the manga have been shrunk down to have multiple original pages fit on one page.

title.native: 呪われたマンガファン

204229.description:
The gravitational pull of the moon causes the body to float, causing a condition known as "Moon Child Syndrome." This is a story of a "floating" child, woven by Tsukishima-kun, one of those affected, and Tsuchiya-san, a classmate.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 月の子症候群～浮いてる僕らの恋のあれこれ～
title.romaji: Tsuki no ko Shoukougun: Ui Teru Bokura no Koi no Arekore

204230.description:
1. Hasami Onna (ハサミ女) [Hana Umeno]
2. FRIEND DOLL (FRIEND DOLL) [Azusa Tachibana]
3. Yuki no Hi (雪の日) [Nao Takami]
4. Eternal Swan (Eternal Swan) [Kidachi]
5. Zashiki Warashi no Iru Tokoro (座敷童子のいるところ) [Youko Nanami]

204231.description:
In order to repay her father's debt of 2,000 taels, Wang Lihe, the daughter of a merchant family, is to marry the son of the notorious feudal lord, King Chengzhou. However, the groom is already deceased. This marriage is known as a "ghost marriage."

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

204232.description:
Akari is a 42-year-old single mother. She signs up to apps every day to look for a new husband, but the only ones who give her "likes" are older men... One day, she falls for a young, handsome dad in her neighborhood... but is hurt when he asks her, "Are you neglecting your kids and using a dating app?" However, the next man she matches with is a highly educated, super handsome guy!? She is determined to find happiness! A heart-warming romantic comedy about a single mother's search for a partner!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: Shin Mama (42), Appli de Unmei no Koi wo Mitsukemasu.

title.native: シンママ（４２）、アプリで運命の恋を見つけます。
title.romaji: Shin Mama (42), Apuri de Unmei no Koi wo Mitsukemasu.

204233.description:
"Is there an affair you want to end?" Meguro Miyabi and Kamijou Kohaku are skilled breakup specialists. They are approached daily with infidelity problems. This time, the client is a wife who is troubled by her husband's affair with a temporary worker. In order to break up her husband and his lover, Kohaku moves into the apartment next to the one where the lover lives, but... the buddy relationship between Miyabi and Kohaku is also attracting attention.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 不倫キャンセル界隈～別れさせ屋～

204234.description:
Kurokome's hobby is visiting cabaret clubs. One day, he is shocked to find out that his entertainment expenses are not deductible. He thought it was just a dream, but then he finds himself a hostess himself!? The hidden side of his superiors, the unfunny jokes of customers, and sexual harassment... What he thought was a glamorous world is actually extremely tough! But he still aims to be number 1, and he will do his best as a hostess with a beautiful appearance and an old man's heart ★

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 転生キャバ嬢は元おじさん^_-☆
title.romaji: Tensei Kyaba Jou wa Moto Oji-san ^_-☆

synonyms: Kiku no Urami Onna ga Nikui

204236.description:
The modern-day gods and deities fantasy manga centers on Shiori, an ordinary college student who has been able to see strange things since she was a child. On the verge of losing her job after her employer goes bankrupt, Shiori gets introduced to a "certain job," in which all the Japanese gods, goddesses, and deities are the clients.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: やおよろず取扱説明書

204237.description:
Lee Yeon-Woo, taking his fourth civil service exam, barely survives the Human Qualification Test that turns humans into beasts and receives a job offer from a suspicious company called the ‘Human Protection Corporation’. Can Yeon-Woo, as an investigator for the Anomaly Investigation Team of the Human Protection Company, which isolates, secures, and studies anomalies to protect humanity, protect the human world and survive to the end?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

204238.description:
After her family was destroyed, Aria Su was left with no choice but to sell herself to pay the debts. But, the man that ended up buying her, was her enemy, the man that forced her father to his death -- Haden Yan. From that point on, Aria lost her freedom and was forced to stay by Haden's side. The man held her captive, but... he also hugged her with his heavily wounded body and said, "I've waited a thousand years for you, so I don't mind waiting a little longer. But, if you'll eventually be mine, I hope you don't make me wait too long."

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: Long Live My Dear Prince Consort

204239.description:
When Ning Chen, a scientist of the 21st century, arrives in a different dimension and possesses the body of the Dark Demon, he freaks out as anyone else would. However, what he is completely unaware of this that the wheel of love has started to turn...

(Source: WebComics)

204240.description:
"Hey, if you're not here to fight, spare us the time and yield!"

Wu Yuan is often ridiculed by his colleagues for not being a very talented cultivator. One day, he gets stabbed in the back by an unknown enemy. When he opened his eyes again, he's traveled ten years in the past. In order to avoid the mistakes he once made, Wu Yuan goes through trials to finally attain immortality and become a talented cultivator. But he fails a second time! Luckily he's got one last chance. Will third time finally be the charm?

(Source: Comikey)

title.native: スノードロップ─あなたの死を望みます─
title.romaji: Snow Drop: Anata no Shi wo Nozomimasu

204242.description:
Kuru-chan lives happy days every day. She enjoys delicious meals, a comfortable home, and is loved dearly by her honest and kind mother. However, her mother is still not happy enough. That is why Kuru believes she must make her mother happier and happier. Because her mother's happiness is her own happiness. She believes she was born for that purpose.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

204243.description:
“If you're worried because I'm young, I can just study hard and make you proud, right?”

Min Jun-Young and Ko Yun-Woo grew up like brothers, sharing joys and sorrows across a single house. One day, Jun-Young realizes the person he slept with after drinking wasn't just a one-night stand. It was Yun-Woo. Just as he tries to apologize, Yun-Woo unexpectedly proposes a three-round challenge in bed.

“Would you want to roll around in bed with the kid who sucked on Pororo drinks while I was drinking soju?!”

Yet, he keeps getting entangled with Yun-Woo, who circles around him, looking out for him. Each time, despite his mind pushing him away, his worn-out body responds honestly to the eight-years-younger kid. After three nights together, will their relationship end, or will they become the lovers she’s always longed for?

Note: The third story in Metatoon's Yeonhagong Danpyeonseon (연하공 단편선) Collection.

204244.description:
When I threw up in front of my first love who confessed to me, the one who came to me was... my first love's older brother?

I have this habit of throwing up when I get nervous. One day, my first love, whom I'd liked for so long, confessed to me, and I ended up throwing up right in front of them. I was drowning my sorrows in alcohol when someone appeared before me. It was my first love's older brother, Hyun-Seok. After pouring out everything I could and couldn't say to him, the alcohol made my memory fade...

When I opened my eyes again, lying next to me was... none other than my friend's brother, completely naked?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

204245.description:
"Excuse me! Do you have a wish?!"

December, as Christmas approaches. Min-Te, a passionate new elf at Santa Inc., tasked with delivering gifts to people, is assigned to an adult project site. His first mission is to fulfill as many customer wishes as possible over a month to fill up his ‘happiness fuel’. Can he succeed in the project before Christmas?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: Knock Knock - Your Gift Has Arrived!

title.english: The Runaway Girl I Picked Up Was a Good-For-Nothing ~After~
title.native: 続拾った家出娘がポンコツだった件
title.romaji: Zoku Hirotta Iede Musume ga Ponkotsu datta Ken

204248.description:
Espin never meant to get main character syndrome, but what choice is there when you wake up in a romance fantasy world? Now the unnamed extra of a novel, Espin knows that by the law of cliches, she's destined to become the main character… But the three male leads aren't getting with the program. Every attempt young Espin makes to help them ends in trouble, and soon she starts to doubt her so-called destiny. Is Espin really this world's new heroine, or does she belong in the sidelines after all?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Thought I Was the Main Character

title.english: An Extra's Accidental Main Character Syndrome

204250.description:
“Heroes of the Nine Great Gates of the Nation---!!”

Rising with righteous fury against the nation's peril, Nungunbi, the Suncheon Gate Master and leader of the Nine Great Gates faction. But betrayed by the Eight Generals he trusted, the nation fell and he slipped into a coma...

Ten years later, he miraculously awoke, only to hear news of the traitors living in luxury.

“A gentleman's revenge is never too late, even after ten years.”

Nungunbi's fury, as heavy as the weight of time itself, now demands retribution!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

204251.description:
Princess Alina of a fallen kingdom, having endured countless deaths, resolved to finally live a peaceful life. She changed her name to “Lise Kruger” in an enemy nation and lived quietly as a cook. But one day, the boy she saved turned out to be the tyrannical prince who killed her in a past life! She had been cooking to survive, yet he declared, “Only your cooking will do,” unexpectedly making her his personal chef!? A fate that keeps them apart, a healing table, and an inescapable bond.

A new story of life and love, woven together by “cooking,” begins.

(Source: Piccoma, translated)
synonyms: I Ended Up Becoming the Villain's Personal Chef

title.romaji: Shi ni Modori Oujo, Boukun no Senzoku Chef ni Nacchaimashita

204252.description:
The otome game "Her Majesty's Blessing" is about a protagonist who is hooked on the edgy setting in which all the characters die, and ends up dying in an accident. When she comes to, she finds herself faced with a person who calls himself God. He asks her to "reincarnate into the game and save everyone," and although she is confused, she decides to reincarnate. When she wakes up, she finds herself as Rouge, a supporting character in the game... An alternate world fantasy where she breaks the death flag and aims for a happy ending!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 脇役転生した乙女は死にたくない～死亡フラグを折る度に恋愛フラグが立つ世界で頑張っています！～
title.romaji: Wakiyaku Tensei Shita Otome wa Shinitakunai: Shibou Flag wo Oru Tabi ni Renai Flag ga Tatsu Sekai se Ganbatte Imasu!

204253.description:
The Jeokun Mountains, the immediate border between the Demon Tribe and the Alien Federation. It is the final strategic point where training and actual combat take place simultaneously. The Federation forces are searching for the ten Transcendents revealed in the Book of Prophecy and reclaiming their lost territories, conducting repeated conscription and selection processes. However, more terrifying than the war with the Demon Tribe were the absurdities and harsh treatment of military life.

(Source: Naver, translated)

204257.description:
It is the first freshman club retreat—the kind of night meant for excitement and budding romance. However, Kim Seon-Wu finds his heart sinking when he discovers that the senior he’s been pining for already has someone in her life. His jealousy flares toward Noh Sang-Yun, a fellow student with a rough, delinquent appearance who seems to be his primary romantic rival. The tension between them peaks during a reckless search for a local "haunted spot," resulting in Seon-Wu and Sang-Yun becoming stranded alone together in the wilderness.

Seeking shelter from a sudden downpour, they break into a suspicious, dilapidated house, where Seon-Wu is unexpectedly possessed by a malevolent spirit. As his life hangs by a thread, Sang-Yun drops his rebellious facade and delivers a chilling ultimatum: "If you want to live, do exactly as I say from now on." Seon-Wu had no idea that this "thug" would soon become his literal lifeline.

(Source: Lezhin US)

This time, Ema wants to be loved by the man of her destiny! After being betrayed by her boyfriend and then suffering an accident in despair, she finds herself lost in another world, where she meets the handsome king of the White Country...! 204264.description:
Her parents divorced after a fire. Upon hearing the news of her father's death, Tamura Kanae, an office worker living with her mother, visits the town where they used to live. There she meets a firefighter with the face of an idol and the body of a blue-collar worker! Their hearts immediately ignite, but...!?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

After being cast out from her wolf pack, Yeon resolves to survive on her own, but a chance encounter leads her to share a hut with a handsome young human named Hwan. Against all reason, Yeon finds herself drawn to the dashing human male, but it turns out... he’s a wolf, too?!

(Source: Manta)

204271.description: Shotaro Kuzukake, a high school boy whose only family went missing during a trip. The ones who came to help him were his strongest stepmothers!? They take care of everything, from housework to daily life!! An unpredictable harem romantic comedy filled with stepmothers begins!!

204283.description:
"Please fuck me so hard I die...!"

Mizuho is your average, burnt-out employee working at a horrible, soul-sucking company. Just as he's about to take his life on account of the stress, he remembers that if he kicks the bucket now, he'll die a total virgin. To die in such a manner is completely unforgivable, so he decides that he absolutely has to get laid beforehand. However, his attempts at finding someone on a dating app aren't working, leaving him even more upset than before. It's then that a grade-A hunk finds him down on his luck and offers to "take good care of him". Invigorated with the spirit of life once again, what fate awaits Mizuho?

A BL love comedy featuring the blinded-by-love Mizuho and the hunky savior who appears out of nowhere to save him from his despair!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: If I'm Gonna Die, I'm at Least Getting Laid First!

title.romaji: Douse Iku nara Shinu hodo Daite

204284.description:
"I'll turn you into the best top there's ever been!"
Can the caring, handsome frontman really turn his sweet and innocent groupmate into a whole-package top?!

Seiya, the frontman of pop sensation Sol4, always spoils the group's youngest member, Haruto. From fixing his mic, to touching up his clothes, Seiya acting like a caring parent has become part of his usual routine. But one day, Haruto excitedly tells Seiya about a lead role in a new TV show he landed... as the perfect BL top! Seiya can't help but worry after thinking about all of Haruto's baby-like antics, and decides it's his duty as a frontman to pretend to be a bottom to help Haruto get into the role. However, Haruto's expression suddenly shifts, and he turns toward Seiya...

(Source: Coolmic)

204287.description:
Ray, the star all strong admire, is Haons' top-class master. Before the final hurdle to becoming a god, Ray is betrayed by his submaster, Anus, and dies. He returns to his days as the "strongest loser, Kang Tae-Wook," trampled by bullies and unable to protect his fiancée. Kang Tae-Wook once again seeks revenge on those who betrayed and ignored him, the things he couldn't accomplish. However, there's another reason he had to live with his miserable past. Kang Tae-Wook plunges into an abyss of conspiracy that deepens the deeper he delves into, and the second installment of his blood-soaked life begins!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: トップクラスマスターの帰還

204288.description:
To clear his name, regressor Bae Min-Su is reincarnated as Go Ji-Hun, the youngest son of a wealthy family, and becomes a police officer to track down the real culprit. A crime thriller boasting incredible wealth begins!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: The Reincarnated Cop Who Strikes With Wealth
転生警察～事件は札束で解決します～

204289.description:
Yuren is the eldest son of a prestigious family, and is expected to become the strongest. However, the job he desired was not or , but the extremely weak . In fact, in Yuren's previous life, he was a modern-day person who played this world as a game. He was bored of simply becoming strong! He wanted to enjoy restricted play by choosing a low-level and weak job! After enraging his father and being kicked out of the house, he began his journey with a perverted playstyle!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: レベル1で挑む縛りプレイ!

204290.description:
At Kangsan High School, one of the nation's most troubled schools, Gu Se-Ra is the top student. Her childhood crush, her older boarder, Lee Seo-Jun, comes to Kangsan High School for a teaching internship, and she experiences numerous hardships with the troubled students. To protect her crush, Gu Se-Ra resolves to transform this troubled school into a model one.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: 鉄槌女子～拳一つで問題校改革～

204291.description:
A So-So Match on a Dating App…

Haida, cursed with chronic bad luck, signs up for a dating app as part of her “what-the-heck” phase. She matches with Kuroi, a man who joined for equally reckless reasons. But their conversation never quite clicks, and an unmistakably low-key, awkward mood sets in. Everything they do backfires, resulting in a date that is astonishingly unexciting. Thinking there’s no way there will be a second date in an atmosphere like this… wait, what? Why are they making plans to meet again!?

A first date with someone you met on a dating app that just doesn’t take off? The deadpan, surreal banter is way too addictive! A slow-burn, gently unfolding romance that begins with a dating app.

title.native: 盛りあがらないデート

204292.description:
Isuzu, a female college student at Kamome University, loves alcohol. Every night she goes out drinking with Hinata, who lives in the next room, and the other residents of the same apartment, but it seems like their "snacks" are a little unusual...

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

204294.description:
Manga loving Kawauchi-kun's "oshi" is his schoolmate Matsumoto. While never intending to catch his oshi's attention, Matsumoto one day takes notice of the attention he's being paid..!?

Not yet friends, not lovers, but they seem interested in one another, a chatty kansai-ben "boy's life" story.

(Source: Leed-sha)

204295.description:
The dream stage, the fashion survival show "Human Wearable". Students who were orphans but graduated from the prestigious "Sunbaek Fashion Arts School" are born on this stage, and the protagonists who turn their lives aroundare born—

… But something, something strange, began to go wrong.

(Source: Naver, translated)

204296.description:
Lee Ryu-Jin, a writer struggling with a slump, stumbles into a relationship with his fan and gangster, "Second." The writer, desperate to overcome his slump, and the gangster, eager to learn how to write, form a bond of necessity. Through this exchange, the two gradually change, but "Second"'s world refuses to leave him alone...

(Source: Naver, translated)

High school students Mayama and Sayama are best friends since childhood and do everything together.
But lately, Sayama seems to be getting a lot of attention from the girls…?
Something is about to change between these inseparable boys.

204313.description:
Wu Linggen, once the chubby kid who was constantly bullied, suddenly dies from a heart attack brought on by his weight, only to awaken in a completely different world. With a fierce determination to finally build a strong body, he quickly realizes that he’s in a realm of cultivation—where those without spiritual roots are deemed worthless. At first, he believes his newfound muscles might just help him scrape by in this bizarre land of monsters and demons. But he didn’t expect that his fists could punch through the entire world of immortal cultivation!

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

204315.description:
Shuri, the ace of the popular idol group Cas/DOVE, has someone he can’t forget. It’s Mashiro Hou, who was once in the same group with Shuri, but now reigns as a solo star.

They had promised to debut together, but that dream was never realized, and Shuri can only try to chase after him — his one and only light.

Years have passed since his first love turned sour, until one day when Mashiro suddenly moves into the dorm where Cas/DOVE lives together. Their initial reunion is brief. But at night, Mashiro crawls into Shuri’s bed and sweetly seduces him.

“Hi, I’m ‘Ran,’ Mashiro’s other personality.”

With the appearance of “Ran,” a dormant love from the past begin to stir once again—!

(Source: ShuCream, translated)

204318.description:
The young man Mirza is enshrined as a "living goddess" who heals his people in the Mansion of Flowers, but in truth, he possesses no healing powers of his own. That miracle is entirely due to the divine water residing in the mountains of his homeland. One night, he saves a young foreigner struck down by a cursed poison, only for his secret to be discovered. The true identity of this young man is Asura, the "Headhunting King" of a neighboring land.

As curses and faith intertwine, the two find themselves drawn to each other, crossing boundaries of both kingdom and god. But their feelings are strictly forbidden. And so, they are swept away by the turbulent waves of destiny...

(Source: Libre, translated)

We were all cute and cool, and Mao was always in the middle. Until that day, when the zombies appeared...

Led by leader Mao, the seven-member group "Mao Seven" continues to enjoy the brilliance of their youth as charismatic figures among the young. However, the sudden onset of the zombie plague has shaken the bond between the seven members...

204434.description:
After a series of unexplained deaths marked by a cryptic symbol, three individuals find themselves entangled in a mysterious phenomenon with no known origin. What begins as a source of unexpected fortune soon grants them everything they once desired--love, opportunity, and control. But the gift comes at a cost. As strange instructions appear and reality begins to fracture, they realize the force behind it is quietly taking over their lives… and their survival. Beneath its guise of luck lies something far more dangerous. The question is: can they recognize misfortune before it’s too late?

(Source: WEBTOON)

204435.description:
Only a swordmaster can slay another. Arhan believed the tales of Liam Karavan, the founding father of his house, were nothing more than legend, until a deadly swordmaster slaughtered everyone dear to him. In his darkest hour, Liam comes to him as a guiding spirit, revealing the true power of their bloodline--the power to devour blades and inherit the strength and memories held within. With each sword consumed, Arhan draws one step closer to vengeance. To avenge his loved ones and restore House Karavan to its former glory, he must survive the perilous path to becoming a swordmaster.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ซอร์ดมาสเตอร์ผู้กลืนดาบ

204437.description:
It's got a strong smell, some nicotine, and no isopropyl alcohol. But you can take a breather in this semi-basement cafe. It's a hotbed of true feelings. A wife troubled by her abusive husband, a gal who doesn't belong at school, a newly divorced editor... This cafe is naturally supportive of its customers who are living stressful days, and sometimes even intervenes with force. The cafe is run by Fujiko, the owner with her grey hair and a secret; Etsuko, the baby-faced waitress; and Kamuzo, the plump mascot dog. This is a refreshing comedy about women who can't wait and cut through the "tiresome everyday life."

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: ホーム・スイート・ホーム

204440.description:
Nanjo Yuto (27), a professional gamer. This is the passionate and earnest story of a man who puts everything into team-based battle royale games. FPS is rage!!!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

204441.description:
The idol I'd dedicated 10 years of my life to as a fan retired. I was in despair, but the next thing I knew, I was a second-year high school student... I had to relive my youth in order to meet my first love again!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

204442.description:
A 26-year-old salesman selling green juice. A 66-year-old veteran bluesman. Their lives have been swapped!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: ブルーブルーそしてブルース

204446.description:
Haruto had been eagerly awaiting his summer vacation reunion with his beloved big brother, only to be devastated when his mother told him the visit was canceled. But then... there he was! His brother, the one he'd been waiting for all along! The two enjoy their summer to the fullest with bug catching, soccer, and fireworks, but then...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

204447.description:
This is a youthful boxing drama about two young men who meet in a juvenile detention center and aim to break down -- mow down the roughnecks and change their lives with just their fists!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: BLUE FIGHT～蒼き若者たちのブレイキングダウン～

204448.description:
The legendary master thief is supposed to be a criminal of the century, but he turns into a child and becomes part of a police family?! Master Thief Lupin always manages to slip through the police's cordon and steal valuable jewels. It should have been easy as usual. However, that day, immediately after stealing the jewels, he was shot by someone, and when he came to, he had transformed into a child! And unfortunately, the family that took in the child Lupin was the very police family that had always been chasing him! He can't escape from this eccentric family, no matter how hard he tries! If his true identity is revealed, he'll be arrested immediately! A thrilling master thief action story begins!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

Fighting with a sword held between your buttocks... that's what a Ketsu Battler does!

(Source: CoroCoro)

204455.description: Tamako Kawashima, a member of her school’s track and field club, is a regular competitor at the national inter-high championships in pole vaulting. One rainy day during the summer holidays, following a certain incident, she resolves to search for a way to bring her deceased teacher back to life. She embarks on this journey alongside her childhood friend, Minato Takahama, and three other students who bear mysterious burn marks.

title.native: まなざし珠子の自由研究

204456.description:
Lee Jae-Ha knows it’s absurd for him to ask for Jang Tae-Geon’s hand in marriage. While Jae-Ha is the heir to Korea’s most prestigious corporation, Tae-Geon is a violent gangster. But above all, both of them are dominant alphas. So when they inevitably do get married, Jae-Ha doesn’t dare to ask for anything more, instead drawing lines in the name of respecting the man he selfishly fell in love with. But these lines only end up aggravating Tae-Geon, who’s actually had his eyes on Jae-Ha just the same...

(Source: Tappytoon)

204457.description:
Five years ago, Winston and Yu-Jin fell deeply and irrevocably in love at first sight. But their passionate relationship shattered when Winston discovered the unthinkable truth: Yu-Jin’s was having an affair with none other than his own father. Consumed by betrayal, Winston channeled the love he once cherished into resentment. Yet no matter how hard he tries, Winston cannot extinguish the pull he still feels. Now, reunited by fate and unresolved wounds, passion and scorn intertwine… But can either of them truly escape what they once meant to each other?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 男風呂チャレンジ…失敗!サウナで囲まれ…
title.romaji: Otokoburo Challenge... Shippai! Sauna de Kakomare...

204459.description:
In a school filled with humanoid creatures of all kinds, one cowgirl is at the top of the high school hierarchy. Tall and beautiful Ushiyama has got it all: looks, smarts, and serious volleyball skills. She’s beloved by all at school, but especially by one shy and small-statured batboy. Will someone like Ushiyama ever give him the time of day or is it better to admire her from afar?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: オトコノコとの甘い体験×5

204464.description:
Kim Seo-Jun, a former high school teacher. Having tasted life's bitterness through stocks and cryptocurrency, Kim Seo-Jun discovers countless gold coins during a school trip. But the moment he picks them up, he is cursed and falls into a martial arts world. Kim Seo-Jun, who wants to live well in the martial arts world with enough gold coins to last a lifetime, and the System that wants to exploit him any way it can. And then there's the ‘modern figure’ who arrived in the martial arts world before Kim Seo-Jun. Now begins Kim Seo-Jun's epic martial arts saga, complete with skulls.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: 人生こじらせて武侠世界に来ました

204465.description:
The protagonist, wandering the martial arts world carrying the secret of the red dot, enters Gaebong through a chance encounter with a legendary figure. His master, who had taught him absolute martial arts, dies mysteriously. With the death of his mentor, a pillar of the Gaebong faction, the Gaebong faction gradually declines. The protagonist decides to leave Gaebong to investigate his master's death and create a new Gaebong that will not be ignored.

(Source: Naver, translated)

204467.description:
By day, Felix Sheng is an elite CEO, but by night, he secretly moonlights as a thirst streamer... One day, a handsome, carefree rich kid landed at the company to be his assistant, he had no choice but to put up with him while carefully guarding his own secret identity. However, this seemingly innocent rich kid was hiding a secret even crazier than his own. In this game of “who’ll slip up first,” Felix discovered that he was the one who had fallen into the trap.

(Source: WebComics)

204468.description:
As an impaired Omega, Yin Ran had assumed he’d live out his remaining years in peace. Unfortunately, he was suddenly kidnapped one day... and the abductors turned out to be his underclassmen from high school! Beside being shocked, his dormant scent gland — which was damaged and numbed for years — was stimulated under the double-dose of pheromones, reawakening his long-slumbering heat cycle…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
