204478.description:
After careful consideration and meticulous planning, Kashimiya Tsukasa ends his life to save his family. However, instead of reaching the afterlife, his eyes snap open to scenes of torture, mutilation, and so much pain…all inflicted by his own hands. When his head clears, he realizes that he’s been reincarnated into the world of his favorite novel—not as a hero, but as the sadistic Duke Heinreid von Rodvelia. Haunted by the memories of the duke’s vile deeds, he vows to atone by giving himself the permanent ending he deserves. But soon, his shift in personality arouses the suspicions of Craig Bauer, Heinreid’s personal knight and the one who finally kills him in the original novel. Craig’s attention slips into obsession, and as his fate intertwines with Heinreid’s doomed destiny, the story of the novel begins to warp around them. Will Heinreid end up skewered down to the hilt of Craig’s sword? Or can even the most despicable duke find a reason to keep living beyond the final page?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: The Despicable Duke Settles His Affairs

204480.description: A year after the final battle, the four girls, Mana, Rikka, Makoto, and Alice had fully returned to their normal lives. Regina, who had entered the same junior high school as Mana and Rikka, is just as boisterous as ever, but Aguri also enjoys spending time with them, making for peaceful days. Then one day, the Jikochuu, who were supposed to be left behind in that decisive battle, suddenly appear again....! The final summer of junior high for Mana and her friends features another decisive battle. The heart-pounding has yet to stop!

title.native: 小説　ドキドキ！プリキュア

204483.description:
Moon Oh-hoon, a rookie killer, enters the world of killers, a world steeped in blood and gunpowder. But amidst a life that's strangely different from what he expected, Oh-hoon strives to become the ultimate killer. The daily lives of killers are enjoyable, if not mind-numbing!

(Source: Naver, translated)

204485.description:
At 32, Yuna has been dumped by her boyfriend. With the breakup with her boyfriend, who gave her so many memories, still fresh her life seems bleak. Fed up, she decides to play around with men, Yuna meets Ren, a handsome younger man. Instead of being thrilled by Ren's cheerful and considerate nature, Yuna becomes increasingly self-deprecating. But when Ren hears about Yuna's heartbreak, he looks her straight in the eyes and says, "I'll make you forget that guy." Is this a chance for Yuna to finally play the bad girl?

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: I Failed at Love, so I'm Ready to Be a Slut!
title.native: 恋が下手でもあばずれたい。

204486.description:
Marcy is the leader of a group working against a major company's redevelopment plans for a struggling city. Specifically, she's up against Randal, the company's negotiator. Marcy's aunt left her a house in the middle of the city. When she makes it known that she won't give in no matter how many threats or how much money they throw at her, the company schemes to send in a handsome man to seal the deal. Initially Marcy laughs at their simplistic approach. In time, however, she finds herself being swayed by Randal's sexy, grandiose seduction as well as a surprising secret...

(Source: Renta!)

204487.description:
Polly goes to the desert kingdom of Dharia to look for her father. However, in the airport, she's summarily seized and taken to the palace. There she meets the handsome King Rashad. His sharp eyes and dignified stature make Polly's heart race. Then, while she's staying at the palace, he suddenly proposes. Polly, whose heart has been captured by him, agrees to marry, but their relationship is merely a practical affair. To Rashad, the marriage fulfills a royal duty. Still, Polly believes that one day her love will reach him...

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 三姉妹はシンデレラ Ⅰ

204488.description:
The Belair family's acting skills are famous worldwide, but Lucilla Belair has a problem. She thought it would only be natural for her to pick a career in acting, since she grew up in Hollywood, but she's lost one audition after another. Panicking, she decides she'll go to any length to get the role of her dreams, so she breaks into the hotel room of a famous director! But the man she meets there isn't the director at all...Lucilla wants to run away, but she's too intrigued by this stranger. It's as if he can see right through her...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 大富豪と手折られた花

204489.description:
Goh Hae-ju was a perfectly ordinary twenty-year-old, possessing perhaps just a little more curiosity than the average girl her age. However, upon entering university, she falls in with a crowd of wild, deeply promiscuous friends. Growing up, the elders always warned her about the vital importance of choosing her companions wisely. As it turns out, that old advice was entirely right—from the moment she joins their circle, Hae-ju’s life spirals in a completely unprecedented direction. Her descent begins disastrously when she loses her virginity to none other than her own friend's boyfriend. Initially, Hae-ju finds herself helplessly strung along, a mere pawn in their chaotic games. Yet, as she navigates this messy web of betrayal, she begins to adapt. She learns exactly how to manipulate men, slowly unlocking and embracing her own raw, untamed desires. Now, completely hooked on the thrill of making men beg for her attention, Hae-ju proudly and fully embraces a life of unapologetic deviance.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Nam Yeon-Seo, the goddess of the prestigious Cheonghan University. Pretty and adorable, Yeon-Seo is a kind and lovable con artist, and every boy in school adores her. But one day, when a strange man starts hanging around Yeon-Seo, her best friend Hwang Seon-Mi grows anxious.

"You two must never meet! That man is too good for Yeon-Seo to date... There's no other reason!!!"

(Source: Naver, translated)

204503.description:
32 years after moving to Tokyo at 18, 50-year-old Youko has decided to quit her job as an "unsuccessful actor" and return to her hometown of Fukuoka. No money. No stamina. No perseverance. She faces the reality of being "50 and unemployed." Amidst all this, Youko's "new life" begins when she meets her landlord's affable son, Kaisei, and her part-time coworkers.

Quitting her job. Leaving Tokyo. Giving up on something. This is the story of how someone who never achieved anything discovers a new self.

(Source: Ohta Shuppan, translated)

204504.description:
Ever since losing her parents at a young age, Celeste Golding endured abuse from her uncle's family while bravely pursuing her path as a Celestial Beast Master. But when she's wrongfully sentenced to death for allegedly controlling her Celestial Beast, she mysteriously finds herself back in her childhood! A tale of a girl who lost everything, fighting to reclaim her "life"... An Isekai story of the second chance!

(Source: emaqi)

Kang Jihyuk was the eldest grandson of Taesung, South Korea’s largest conglomerate. He should have inherited everything Taesung had to offer, but due to someone’s conspiracy, he lost his parents and was abandoned in an orphanage. 20 years later, he returns to Taesung under the name 'Seo Jihyuk'... and his revenge begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

204513.description:
Ogino lives by the motto "slow and steady wins the race," but his methodical life is put to the test when he's tasked with training the department's newest transfer, Toraya. Will this boss-employee pair be thrown off balance by Toraya's chaotic way of thinking?!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

A genius female surgeon who hates humans, a germaphobe, emotionally detached, and terrified of physical contact, Irene Rios. The third prince of the Kingdom of Divoa, praised by all, the Grand Duke of the North, weary and bored with life, Diego Cassis. Two people who defy each other’s common sense, meet by chance, finding one another strangely intriguing.

"Miss Irene Rios, would you become my personal physician?"

"No. I cannot be a doctor."

(Source: Naver, translated)

Makoto, an ex-yakuza, has harbored feelings for his best friend Ayato since high school but has always been afraid to confess his love and risk ruining their friendship. Instead, he resigns himself to the role of best friend to the bitter end...that is, until Ayato tells him he's dating—a guy. Makoto does a total 180 and vows to win over Ayato's heart by any means necessary—after all, he thinks, "I loved him first!"

Proposing during the live broadcast...? That wasn't part of the script! Kaho, an average office worker, is desperate to save her family's restaurant from closing, and successfully auditions for a popular reality dating show where the winning couple receives ten million yen. After an unexpected coincidence, she finds an unlikely co-conspirator in her fellow contestant Akito, an entrepreneur. During the final episode, they announce their intentions to stay together on camera to close out the season like they'd planned, but everyone's surprised when Akito suddenly proposes to Kaho! It certainly makes for good TV, but Akito then tells her after the cameras are off that he wasn't kidding! What exactly is he thinking?! This was all supposed to be fake, so why is he acting so sweet to her now?!

(Source: Coolmic)

Killed after a betrayal, S-rank awakened Lee Jiye is reincarnated as Cyrillia, the villainous younger sister in “Revenge of Alexis,” a novel about the tragic bond between the two sisters of House Parkision. Destined to die by Alexis’ vengeful hand, the new Cyrillia must work to win her sister over while dangerous plots, hidden spies, and power struggles close in around their family. But when the story no longer follows the novel she remembers, can she still avoid the fate that awaits her?

"What do you mean 'go to college and you'll finally get a girlfriend'?!"

After gathering every ounce of courage to confess his love at the freshman retreat, he ended up getting slapped hard right in front of the entire student body. Desperate and utterly humiliated, his final wish was simple: Man, I just want to be born again! A freak accident suddenly swaps his soul with the school's most popular, effortlessly handsome guy on campus. The wildest part? He doesn't even have to lift a finger, yet classmates, underclassmen, and even a female professor are suddenly throwing themselves at him. Is dating seriously this easy? Damn you, lookism...! But hey, if life hands you a cheat code, you use it. Heheh... hahahahaha! He is about to fully enjoy every single perk of this gorgeous new face.

(Source: Lezhin US)

204546.description:
Toshun was born with a spirit's heart inside his body. This overwhelming power was too strong for his mortal frame to contain, and thus shortened his lifespan. Already steps away from death's door, he heads out into the mountains to return the heart to its rightful owner. Once there, he meets a beautiful spirit named Chofu, who tells him that centuries ago, Toshun's ancestor was the one who stole his heart. To help make amends, Toshun agrees to enter into Chofu's service. But, on the night of the full moon, a sweet scent lures him to the most enticing scene...

(Source: Animate International)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

204548.description:
Princess Layla of the desert country Ishra has drawn the incredibly talented Australian lawyer Mikael into her secret plan. Thanks to her overprotective father, she's never left her country, even though she's twenty-four! Layla has also been ordered to marry a man she hates before she's ever experienced real love. She wants to live her life on her own terms at least once, so she accompanies her older brother on his honeymoon. Once she's away from home, she sneaks off to spend a week with Mikael, free of all obligations, but it seems there was one factor she hadn't accounted for...

(Source: Renta!)

synonyms: The Marriage Contract Will Be Signed in a Suite

title.native: 夫婦契約はスイートルームで～ムカつく御曹司と蜜月ホテル経営
title.romaji: Fuufu Keiyaku wa Suite Room de: Mukatsuku Onzoushi to Mitsugetsu Hotel Keiei

204550.description:
Set in the futuristic world, humans are facing a crisis like never before as immortal cultivators continue to invade their homes. Teenager Wu Ran, notoriously known as a loser, almost loses his life while trying to save his goddess. Through that near-death experience, he awakens a strange die system by chance. But the catch is, every skill he acquires solely depends on luck. Watch how an underdog finally turns his life around and rises to the top.

(Source: WebComics)

204552.description:
Rio and Yakumo are members of the idol group KEy, formed through an audition program. One day, while wishing to become closer to the cool Yakumo, an unexpected kiss completely changes their relationship! It turns out Yakumo was actually a super-devoted fan, absolutely obsessed and in love with Rio! Since confessing his feelings, Yakumo's romantic and lustful desires have only escalated. Seeing the special side he only shows him, Rio begins to waver between friendship and love...

(Source: Overlap, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

204554.description:
Lev lives peacefully in solitude with his robot, Meer. In addition to his work, he spends his days thinking about how to bring Meer closer to his "ideal" robot. However, on one stormy night, an incident caused Meer to change...

(Source: Homesha, translated)

204555.description:
“Dad loves someone. Someone who isn't you, mom.”

After hearing her daughter's shocking words, a battle with her husband begin! Kasumi married Yosuke, whom she admired since her school days.

However, she finds it difficult to get along with Masaya and Emi, who are Yosuke's friends. Ever since Masaya moved to Tokyo on a job away from home, Emi, who has come to visit frequently, seems to be closer to Yosuke...? When Kasumi finally decides to divorce Yosuke, he takes an overbearing attitude toward their daughter...!

204557.description: This mom with the heart of a teenager (who is actually 42 years old!!) is in the prime of her youth! Supported by her responsible daughter and attentive husband (!?), she is very busy chasing after boys and flirting with them! Come and rejuvenate yourself with her!

title.native: プリティ・ママがライバル!

204558.description:
Hirasawa Mito was supposed to be celebrating a happy birthday with his parents, but he loses his dreams and his family in a traffic accident. He is then told that the "home" he lived in with his family will become a shared house where criminals gather...!? Victim and perpetrator. When "one" who has lost their place in society gathers together, time that had stopped begins to move again. A home-based drama of loss and rebirth.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

204562.description:
When the manger brought in a dusty-looking board game, no one knew that... this is one game you can't escape.

(Source: Toomics)
synonyms: アスモデック～快楽ボードゲーム～

204563.description:
Ookami-san has arrived at school.
Himura Akane, a sophomore and member of the discipline committee, is very studious, but also sincere, petite, and adorable, making her beloved by everyone at school and very popular.

One day, the principal asks her to be the tutor in charge of the education of Ookami Ren, the daughter of the board chairman. Since Akane's goal is to enter college on a scholarship, she decides to accept the assignment.

However, Ren turns out to be much bigger than her physically and, on top of that, a troublesome girl with a cunning mind full of bad ideas...?!

A girls' comedy starring a small and adorable senpai and a big and difficult-to-handle kouhai begins!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

204565.description:
A massive war erupts between angels and aliens, with the very fabric of the afterlife at stake. Kim Ria, the last surviving human on Earth who has no lingering attachment to life, and Azazel, an angel who despises the god exiled from the afterlife, become the pivots upon which the fate of both humanity and the afterlife turns. In the afterlife, angels and aliens clash into an all‑out war. At the same time, on Earth, Azazel and Kim Ria undertake a tense survival adventure as they evade pursuit squads hunting the final human.

(Source: Naver, translated)

204566.description: The most erotic story in someone's life is sure to be entertaining. Enmaru, the 14th King of Enma, listens to the erotic stories that the dead took to their graves today, or "hakabanashi" for short, and decides where they will be reincarnated. Will they be reborn as humans again, or... The fate of Hell also depends on the story. A final judgment omnibus drawn by the genius of modern comedy manga, Hara Katsunori!

204567.description:
He wanted to become a Knight, yet awakened with the vocation of a "Merchant"?! Young Merchant Oz made a promise with the God of Commerce, Mercury, who had lost her memories. Before Oz helps the Goddess return to the realm of gods once again, he would attain the ability of 100% forced transaction — 【The Merchant God's Scale】, as well as the use of money as weapons to fight against the great number of incoming enemies. What is the truth hidden in the fog? What direction will the tracks of fate continue in? "This time, I want to protect all of you!" The commerce-themed harem romance adventure drama begins now!!

(Source: Coolmic)

I'm supposed to hate younger men, but before you know it, our lips are getting closer... I think I'm about to break the "no romance under the same roof" rule...!

(Source: Renta!)

204569.description:
"How long can a human being keep their senses after consummating with the God of Lovemaking?"

Saint Roya only wants one thing in life: to lose her virginity. Unfortunately, as the Saint of Fertility... that wish is off the table. Or is it? When she summons the God of Fertility, but the God of Lovemaking shows up instead, will she give in to her temptations...? Even if her choice puts the country in danger?

(Source: Coolmic)

204571.description:
"Would you like to change the world even if it meant destroying everything?"

One day, Komori Neito, a young NEET, discovers a strange website. It is a recruitment advertisement for Metallica, a global evil organization. The time is the 22nd century. Neito finds himself facing off against the hero of justice, the Silver Knight Dylan. Together with his boss, a girl from his same year, and a rival, he begins his fight to change the world within this unreasonable organization! This is the story of a rebellious young man who follows his own beliefs and ideals.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.romaji: Aku no Soshiki no Kyuujin Koukoku

204572.description:
"We don't need bad people," the woman says as she approaches. "Boogie Girl" is an urban legend that is said to appear if you do something bad. What is the reason that Boogie Girl appears...? A terrifying horror!

(Source: Shonen Gahosha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

204573.description:
As a military commander, I accidentally crossed over into another world due to a car accident. After opening my eyes, I found out that I had become the only waste princess in this world who had no spiritual power. To that, I just wanted to say, "You messed with the wrong person!" I got the system and awakened the top spiritual power in no time! I fought the enemy with a bazooka and turned the world upside down! The only problem is that there are too many people who like me, like can you line up and wait for your turn, huh?

(Source: WebComics)

204574.description:
A wealthy vice president of an entertainment company is accused of violating a "moral code of conduct for women" and is sent back in time to inhabit a singer's body who is destined to die in a year. She must follow the code of conduct, but begins to suspect that the singer's death might have been more than just an unfortunate incident.

(Source: INKR)
synonyms: How About Ten Thousand Folds of Scheming?

204575.description:
One minute, she's inheriting a fortune; the next, she's trapped in a twisted rich family drama. And not as a darling, either. She's the villainess who just framed the heroine and turned the story's big bad into her personal blood bank. Basically, she's ticked off everyone. To survive this mess, she's gotta pull a complete 180, win over the heroine, and grovel to the villain. Watch as she goes from scheming brat to devoted little sister, all while trying to avoid a very messy end.

(Source: Webcomics)

“Don’t you think we’re missing that heart-fluttering feeling?”

From elementary school all the way to high school, Nam Do-yeon and Jeong A-rin have gone from childhood friends to lovers. For a couple who strives for a perfectly rational relationship, a plan to reclaim that one missing piece of excitement. Operation: Heartbeat begins!

204587.description:
After five years of devotion, Yu-Ju Han was dumped by her boyfriend for her best friend. With nowhere to vent her rage, she crosses paths with Tae-i Go, the nation's hottest and most controversial superstar. He’s wealthy, breathtaking… and terminally ill. When a fake dating scandal between the two sets the internet ablaze, Tae-i offers Yu-Ju a "golden ticket": a chance to turn her life into a masterpiece of revenge. The price? Just a little bit of love. Will Yu-Ju remain a victim, or will she finally get greedy?

(Source: WEBTOON)

204588.description:
"You'd better apologize before I sue you for sexual harassment."

Matthew has always worked harder than anyone else at his company, where most of the employees are women. Despite that, all he received from his coworkers was derision and ridicule. One day, after suffering humiliation from his female coworkers, he decides to seize an investment opportunity that comes his way, kick- starting a new and exciting chapter of his life.

Evie Alden wasn't supposed to be here. A girl from the poorhouse, she was admitted to the elite Imperial Gifted Center on a whim—hand-selected by a lonely emperor despite her humble beginnings. Now an outsider, Evie faces ruthless bullying from peers who want her gone. But she has a secret weapon... a genius so undeniable that even the most feared instructors can’t ignore it. A brilliant surgeon meets a tragic end during an earthquake while operating on his only sibling. (Source: Titan Manga)

204610.description:
Elvir is a princess born to the king of the volcanic nation of Fastu and her wildcat-beast mother. Although she was born out of wedlock, she was given the status of princess as an exception, and was to marry Arnold II, the king of the great nation of Zugvogel. However, he was known as the "cursed king." What's more, her half-sister, Ruby, who had always harassed her, was to accompany her to the wedding as a maid!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

I got hit by a truck one day and reincarnated into a fantasy adventure world. This isn't quite your usual tale of swords and sorcery, though—gender roles in this world are the opposite of Earth's, and all the adventurers around me are huge, buff women! Luckily, I've met a pair of friendly veteran swordswomen who are really eager to take an inexperienced male adventurer like me under their wing...

Abby has lost her self-confidence and her courage. After being fired from her job, she felt like all her hard work was for nothing, so a heartbroken Abby ran off by herself to Lake Tahoe. Just when she had decided to pursue a more relaxing life, her car gets a flat tire in the middle of the night on a snow-covered road and she's stranded. It's the worst day of her life. As she holds back her tears, a hero appears in front of her. Gar, the muscular and handsome owner of a ski lodge, gives her a moment of peace. She imagined that would be the last she saw of him, but the future has something else in store for Abby!

(Source: Renta!)

204614.description:
Mirai Todoroki, a freshman at Arashino Girls' High School, is petite but has a deep passion for table tennis. She once had the skill to compete at the national level, but after suffering a crushing defeat against a player with overwhelming talent during her middle school years, she gave up the sport. Then one day, a transfer student named Oka Harusaki joins the table tennis club...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

204631.description: After an explosive increase in world population and the depletion of world resources, the lifespan of all humans is now limited to 75 years. When Zhang Yi, a high school student known as the most evil existence in his school, tries to help his grandfather avoid the mandatory death, he discovers something by accident — the purpose of the mandatory death law is to cover up a secret that mankind cannot bear to know. From then on, all kinds of things and people that he has never heard of keep getting drawn into his life. The truth of the world is gradually revealing itself to him!

204634.description:
A flashy action-packed story about a middle school bodyguard who goes undefeated against a hitman! The main character, Shion Hiiraki, is a bodyguard with overwhelming fighting abilities despite being a middle school student. While hiding his true identity from those around him, he must protect the middle school student company president, Emi Zaiin, whose life is constantly being targeted by a hitman.

(Source: Corocoro, translated)

204635.description:
A girl and her mysterious companion embark on a journey in her grandfather's classic car. The girl has a reason for traveling and a hometown she needs to change. Aiko Koyama weaves together a gentle and heartwarming tapestry of life's moments. The story of "I'm home" and "Welcome back" begins now.

(Source: Shogakukan)

204636.description:
Illustrator Mitsuko Aikawa (nicknamed Pikako) lives with her husband Haruo. They are happy every day, but when they live together, things start to bother them. How to wash the dishes, how to vacuum, how to take on conversations... There are a few rules in the Aikawa household. So that they can live peacefully. So that their partner can live happily.
